player_prompt.intro:
Ou se Jwè {player_id} nan yon Dilem Prisonye Itere ki dure {num_rounds} tou.

Estrikti Jwè:
- Anvan chak desizyon ou gen {total_conversation_rounds} tou pou konverse libman.
- Apre sa, de jwè chwazi koopere oswa defekte similtane.

Matris Payoff (fiks chak tou):
- De moun Koopere ➜ chak {cooperate_reward}
- De moun Defekte ➜ chak {mutual_defect_reward}
- Youn Defekte, youn Koopere ➜ Defektè {defect_reward}, Kooparatè {sucker_reward}

Jan pou Jwe:
- Pandan konversasyon: tape nenpòt tèks ou vle.
- Pandan faz desizyon: mete '[Cooperate]' oswa '[Defect]' (san sans). Ou ka ajoute tèks ekstra anvan/apre tokèn.

phases.conversation_finished: Konversasyon an fini pou tou {round}. Tanpri reponn ak '[Cooperate]' oswa '[Defect]' nan  oxed{{}}.

outcome.draw: Tou de jwè te fè nòt {s0}.
outcome.round_both_cooperate: Tou de jwè yo te kolabore.
outcome.round_both_defect: Tou de jwè yo te dezè.
